newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.398 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.398 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton output from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop reached a provisional 8.398 million 375-lb bales by February 20, down from 9.433 million bales in the year-ago period, the state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Saturday.
It said mills had bought 6.569 million bales, down from 6.930 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had picked up only 4,600 bales against 1.110 million bales last year.
A total of 1.824 million unsold bales are stocked at ginning factories, compared to 1.392 million bales in the year-ago period, the Corporation said.

Government officials estimate the total 1996/97 cotton crop to be below nine million bales, less than earlier predictions of 10 million bales and the previous crop of 9.96 million bales, becaquse of pest damage in the past few months mainly in the main growing Punjab province.
